fields: L5 Shanghai / Dragon Boat Festival (e-bike; Lujiazui → the Bund → Huaihai Road → Xintiandi). Same item fields as L3 v3.1 / L4. Pools keep L3 names so pickSetL2 + l3TypeUniq can be reused: seawall = 端午摊 Zongzi Stall questions (3–4 choices, timed 30 s; also the retry pool), forest_fork = fork signs (≤3 choices; sign_en/sign_zh; EN ≤24 chars, ZH width ≤12), peak_final = Xintiandi-entrance final (exactly 4 choices, hard, situational). Per run: 3 timed stall in segment 1 + 4 fork in segment 2 + 2 timed stall and 1 Xintiandi final in segment 3 = 10 (one stall pool, drawn as 5 then split 3+2; do not place all 5 timed questions in the first segment). Every item has qtype + qtype_zh (each qtype at most once per run). {name} = player name; English on top, Chinese below. No subject capybara/beaver. Festival riddles are object/animal riddles solvable in both languages (subject 'riddle'), labelled Festival riddle: / 端午谜：. Stems are deduped against all L1–L4 banks (all grades).

questions.q_en: A tidal river's level ____.
questions.q_zh: 感潮河段的水位会____。
questions.explain_en: It follows the sea tide.
questions.explain_zh: 它会随着海潮涨落。
questions.qtype_zh: 水和冰的特性（膨胀/六角/分子/比热）

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A shuttlecock kicked under Huaihai Road plane trees has height h = -4t² + 16t. What is its maximum height?
questions.q_zh: 淮海路梧桐下踢起的毽子高度 h = -4t² + 16t，最大高度是多少？

questions.subject: riddle
questions.q_en: Festival riddle: I form above a steaming pot of zongzi, I am a gas, and I make the lid wet when I cool. What am I?
questions.q_zh: 端午谜：我在蒸粽子的锅上出现，我是气体，冷下来还会把锅盖弄湿。打一物，是什么？
questions.explain_en: Steam is water vapor; it condenses back into drops on a cool lid.
questions.explain_zh: 蒸汽是水蒸气，碰到凉锅盖会凝结成水珠。

questions.subject: shanghai
questions.q_en: Standing on the Bund, you look east across the river toward the tall modern towers of ____.
questions.q_zh: 站在外滩，向东隔江望去，那些高高的现代塔楼是在____。
choices: the open East China Sea horizon only
a mountain valley in another province
questions.explain_en: The Pudong skyline at Lujiazui faces the Bund across the Huangpu.
questions.explain_zh: 陆家嘴的高楼在浦东，和外面的外滩隔江相望。
questions.qtype_zh: 上海地标（陆家嘴/外滩/新天地）

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Green sachets x and gold sachets y: x + y = 25 and x - y = -9. Find x.
questions.q_zh: 绿香囊 x 只、金香囊 y 只：x + y = 25，x - y = -9，求 x。

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A sparrow flock of 4 grows by a factor of 3 every year. How many sparrows after 2 years?
questions.q_zh: 一群麻雀原有 4 只，每年变成原来的 3 倍，2 年后有多少只？
questions.qtype_zh: 指数增长/衰减求值（翻倍、等比）

questions.subject: language
questions.q_en: At Xintiandi the grandma says the welcome line on the wall is from Li Sao. Li Sao is ____.
questions.q_zh: 新天地的阿婆说，墙上那句迎客的话出自《离骚》。《离骚》是____。
choices: a long lyric poem by Qu Yuan
a tide chart for the Bund
questions.explain_en: Li Sao is Qu Yuan's long lyric poem, often remembered around this festival.
questions.explain_zh: 《离骚》是屈原的长篇抒情诗，过端午时常被人提起。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: On the Bund's wet stones, Flora brakes her e-bike and notices she needs more room to stop than on dry Huaihai Road. The main reason is ____.
questions.q_zh: 外滩石板是湿的，Flora 骑电动车刹车时发现，要比在干的淮海路上留出更长的距离才能停住。主要原因是____。
choices: plane trees add extra mass to the bike
lower friction on the wet surface
wet stone makes the motor stronger
a bus is pulling the bike forward
choices_zh: 梧桐会给车子加上额外的质量
潮湿地面上的摩擦更小
湿石头会让电机更有力
公交车在把车子往前拉
questions.explain_en: Water reduces friction between the tyres and the stones.
questions.explain_zh: 水会减小轮胎和石板之间的摩擦。
questions.qtype_zh: 力与运动（摩擦/阻力/牛顿定律）

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A ramp up to the Bund flood wall rises 6 m over a horizontal run of 8 m, with a sloping length of 10 m. What is tan of the ramp's angle?
questions.q_zh: 上外滩防汛墙的坡道升高 6 米，水平距离 8 米，斜长 10 米。坡角的 tan 值是多少？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A bird over the Bund follows h = -4t² + 16t (h in metres, t in seconds). What is its maximum height h?
questions.q_zh: 外滩上空一只鸟的高度 h = -4t² + 16t（h 单位米，t 单位秒），最大高度 h 是多少？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: From a boat on the Huangpu, the two ends of a Bund viewing stretch are 8 and 5 units away, with a 60° angle between the sight lines. How long is that stretch in those units?
questions.q_zh: 在黄浦江的船上看外滩一段观景带的两端，距离分别是 8 和 5 个单位，两条视线夹角 60°。这段有多长（同一单位）？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A banner rope runs 30 m from the Bund deck up to a lamp post at 30° above horizontal. How high is the top of the rope above the deck, in metres?
questions.q_zh: 一根横幅绳从外滩地面拉到灯杆上，长 30 米，与水平面成 30°。绳的顶端离地面多高（米）？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A bird over the Bund rises with height h = -2t² + 15t (in metres). What is h at t = 1?
questions.q_zh: 外滩上空一只鸟的高度是 h = -2t² + 15t（单位：米），t = 1 时 h 是多少？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: On a city grid (units of 10 m), the Bund flood wall is at (4, -1) and Flora's e-bike is at (7, 3). What is the straight-line distance in grid units?
questions.q_zh: 在市区坐标图上（单位 10 米），外滩防汛墙在 (4, -1)，Flora 的电动车在 (7, 3)，两点直线距离是几个单位？
